failures.criterion: `go test ./...` in packages/daemon green. `TestTheBootReadRecordsATodoChildOfALiveTreeThatHasNoRecord` in packages/daemon/internal/admit fails on this branch and passes at its merge base.
failures.evidence: On the head: cd packages/daemon && LEGION_TEST_PG_DSN=<scratch Postgres> LEGION_TEST_NATS_URL=nats://127.0.0.1:24222 LEGION_TEST_NATS_MONITOR_URL=http://127.0.0.1:24223 go test -count=1 -run TestTheBootReadRecordsATodoChildOfALiveTreeThatHasNoRecord ./internal/admit/ -> FAIL, all three subtests ('consumer caught up', 'consumer behind', 'labelled child'), each reporting 'outbox after the boot read = …, want what the two todo events queue, …'. Control, the same command in a `git archive` extract of the merge base ab7c2339950c1754ebb099755b8d22e9a7c3dca0 under the same Postgres and NATS -> ok. The mechanism: boot_child_test.go:91 builds its expectation by running the live events once (`echoed`, which returns `effects(t, pool)`) and then compares that whole outbox against the boot read's with reflect.DeepEqual at :120. This change adds `Assignment` to record.SuperviseRequest, minted fresh per start, so the two runs can never be equal — the diff prints a different ULID on each side of every subtest (E7V3ESIZTOSX2YJA2K5Z4TGKFK against ISBUQ2TNPIUPTN5QRZ3RV235XN, and so on). The test came from main (#2293, aa64baf63) and the branch touches no file under internal/admit, so this is the forward merge's semantic conflict: main added a test that compares two runs' outbox effects while this branch added a per-start random field to them. It cannot be an ordering flake — it reproduced on every run, filtered and whole-package, with the same shape. The fix is the implementer's choice between normalising the assignment out of the comparison (effects() or the test) and having the test compare what the field is allowed to differ in; the red test is in the tree already. Note for the next round, not counted as a failure: this one needs LEGION_TEST_NATS_URL and LEGION_TEST_NATS_MONITOR_URL set, since without them internal/admit's TestCapturedDispatchTodoEventAdmitsAndProjectsActiveSlot panics 'rootless Docker not found' first and the binary never reaches the boot-read test (docs/solutions/testing/the-daemons-nats-tests-run-in-a-docker-less-pod-against-a-local-nats-server-named-by-two-variables-INFRA-388.md).
